# Airgain to Participate in 2026 Vision FirstNet Users Summit


September 02, 2026 8:30am EDT


SAN DIEGO--(BUSINESS WIRE)--[Airgain, Inc. (NASDAQ: AIRG)](https://www.airgain.com/) , a leading provider of advanced wireless connectivity solutions, today announced it will participate in the 2026 Vision FirstNet Users Summit, taking place September 14-16 at the South Point Hotel Casino & Spa in Las Vegas.


Airgain’s participation builds on the Company’s recently announced expansion of its mission-critical connectivity portfolio with FirstNet®, Built with AT&T. The expanded relationship is helping Airgain extend its reach across public safety agencies, utilities, and other critical field operations while supporting product demonstrations, customer trials, integration, and deployment.


At the summit, Airgain will meet with public safety leaders, FirstNet users, and industry partners to discuss evolving field connectivity requirements and how the AirgainConnect® portfolio can support reliable communications across vehicle, fixed, portable, and rapid-response applications.


“The Vision FirstNet Users Summit provides an important opportunity to engage directly with the public safety professionals who rely on dependable connectivity in demanding environments,” said Jacob Suen, Airgain president and CEO. “Our relationship with the FirstNet team at AT&T continues to deepen, and we look forward to working together to help public safety agencies, utilities, and other critical organizations improve connectivity, simplify deployment, and strengthen operational readiness.”


AirgainConnect provides integrated connectivity solutions designed for organizations operating in challenging coverage environments. The portfolio includes AirgainConnect® Fleet™ (AC-Fleet), AirgainConnect MegaFi 2™, Go-Kit Pro™, and MegaGo 2™, providing customers with flexible options for vehicle, fixed-site, portable, and temporary field deployments.


The Vision FirstNet Users Summit is a leading event dedicated to advancing broadband communications for first responders. Organized by the Public Safety Broadband Technology Association and sponsored by FirstNet, Built with AT&T, the summit brings together public safety leaders, policymakers, and technology innovators from across the country. Attendees participate in training, technology demonstrations, and collaborative discussions focused on the future of public safety communications.


Public safety agencies, utilities, and industry partners interested in meeting with Airgain during the summit can contactsales@airgain.com to schedule a meeting.


**About Airgain, Inc.**


Headquartered in San Diego, California, Airgain, Inc. (NASDAQ: AIRG) is a leading provider of advanced wireless connectivity solutions that drive cutting-edge innovation in 5G technology. We are committed to delivering high-performance, cost-effective, and energy-efficient wireless solutions that enable rapid market deployment. Our mission is to connect the world through integrated, innovative, and optimized wireless solutions. Our diverse product portfolio serves enterprises, automotive, public safety, and consumer markets.
